name: Café Liebevoll
kurzbeschreibung: Café Liebevoll in Oberndorf in Tirol – a cozy hideaway where every visit feels like a warm embrace.
beschreibung: The Café Liebevoll in Oberndorf in Tirol in the Kitzbühel region invites guests to enjoy a relaxing and delicious pause. This charming café and bakery delights with a wonderful assortment of homemade tarts, cakes, and regional sweet treats. Every dessert is prepared with passion and served in a warm, welcoming environment. Guests can also enjoy premium barista coffee, refreshing drinks, and a rich breakfast selection that leaves nothing to be desired – the ideal way to start your day in the Alps.
